title: Workforce Solutions-Funded Enrollments: Family Share Credited after Withdrawal, Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program
content:
For a Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program enrollment funded through Workforce Solutions Child Care Services, the credit base is the family's share of the final billed month's tuition charge. It is read from the enrollment's billing history:

| Enrollment and remittances on its billing history | Credit base |
|---|---|
| CCS-funded, and a board remittance has posted for the final billed month | the charge less that month's board remittance |
| CCS-funded, no board remittance has posted for that month yet, but one has posted for an earlier month | the charge less the enrollment's most recent board remittance |
| CCS-funded, and no board remittance has posted on the enrollment at all | the whole charge |
| any other enrollment | the whole charge |

An enrollment is CCS-funded when Workforce Solutions Child Care Services is its third-party funder on record.

## Worked cases (hypothetical figures, final month's charge 310.00)

| Remittances | Credit base |
|---|---|
| 205.00 posted for the final month | 105.00 |
| none for the final month; the most recent, for the month before, 198.00 | 112.00 |
| none ever posted | 310.00 |
| enrollment not CCS-funded | 310.00 |
